selection_rule.excluded_payload: ELF binaries, Cargo target caches, Callgrind *.out or *.callgrind raw, heaptrack *.zst, full timing stdout and fake runner bulk files. Their existing small-file hash/size/path remains in this index where applicable.
selection_rule.gzip: Deterministic gzip, mtime=0, empty filename, level=9; original and gzip identities recorded separately.
selection_rule.indexed: All regular files at most 2 MiB under root, excluding baseline/baseline-harness worktrees, preserved packet-v1, target-* caches, .git, and this command's final receipt.
selection_rule.packaged: Top-level identity/source patches; all build and test receipts/logs/inputs; R1/R2 light manifests and compact JSON; corrected R1/R2 function tables; R1/R2 control summaries/annotated tables; allocator text; RSS resource logs; command metadata; representative runner-failure manifests.
